subject: Research collaboration in Luxembourg — Earth-observation flood evidence for finance (Talaix)
body:
Dear Professor Matgen,

I am the founder of Talaix, a Luxembourg-based technology team working on Earth observation and environmental risk for financial decision intelligence — turning physical evidence about natural hazards into information that investors and lenders can rely on. I live and work in Luxembourg, and I am writing to explore research collaboration, with joint publication as the primary goal.

Your work on hydrological and flood modelling, remote sensing and data assimilation is exactly the evidential layer our work builds on: flood evidence is our primary use case, and the question we keep hitting is how a financial user can tell an observed flood measurement from a modelled estimate.

Concretely: I have developed a declaration standard for the evidential status of physical climate-risk data (observed, documented, reported, modelled, inferred), and a first manuscript — "Provenance-labelled physical climate-risk evidence: a declaration standard for sustainable-finance due diligence" — is currently in the submission process with a peer-reviewed sustainable-finance journal. I would be glad to share the manuscript and the published record schema.

I am open to the form this takes: a co-authored study, joint work with your group, or — in the longer run — doctoral research under your supervision. Would you be open to a short meeting on campus or a call in the coming weeks?

Kind regards,
Motaz OMARIEN
Talaix — Earth Observation & Environmental Risk / Financial Decision Intelligence
Luxembourg-based technology team
info@talaix.com | talaix.com
